[[File:Eriadu_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The atmosphere of Eriadu had a lot of carbon dioxide]]
A greenhouse gas, '''carbon dioxide (CO<sub>2</sub>)''' was a molecule composed of one [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] atom and two [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] atoms. It could create problems in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], heating them up and creating adverse climatic changes. Many [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopoleis]] suffered this problem, including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the polluted [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. [[Atmospheric dampener]]s could be used to remove excess carbon dioxide from the air.  It was poisonous to inhale for many [[Species/Legends|species]].

Scrubbers in [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], such as [[Gandorthral Atmospherics/Legends|Gandorthral Atmospherics]] [[Roamer-6 breath mask/Legends|Roamer-6 breath mask]] could break down carbon dioxide and convert it into breathable [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
